lines.zh: 我背着鼓起的囊在沙上走
lines.en: I walk the sand, a swollen sac on my back.
I crawl slowly; the sac is heavy.

lines.zh: 我身后拖着一条发绿的痕
lines.en: A greenish trace drags behind me.
Six legs take turns bearing me.

lines.zh: 我朝虫群聚集的地方走
lines.en: I head where the swarm gathers.

lines.zh: 沙在我脚下被压出深印
lines.en: The sand presses into deep prints.
Every few steps I pause.
The sac on my back sways gently.
I go around stones so the sac will not burst.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，蚂蚁都散了
lines.en: The ants scatter where I pass.

lines.zh: 我朝着你的方向慢慢去
lines.en: I move slowly toward you.
My legs are thick; my walk is steady.
I walk in the dune's shadow.
I stop and lift the sac.
I start moving again.
I crouch, and the sac still moves.

lines.zh: 我的囊里装满了火药似的东西
lines.en: My sac is full of something like blasting powder.
I dare not go fast.
I wait for the swarm's signal.
The sand is hot, and the sac heats.
My mouthparts are small, only enough to tear.
I listen for distant tremors.
This desert is ours.
I press low to guard the sac.

lines.zh: 我不需要躲，我本来就该被躲
lines.en: I need not hide; I am what others hide from.
Hard spines stud my legs.

lines.zh: 我等一个足够近的距离
lines.en: I wait for a close enough distance.
I turn my back toward you.
My sac swells before you.

lines.zh: 你站得太近，黏液滴下来了。
lines.en: Too close; my slime is dripping.

lines.zh: 我慢慢往后退，不让你碰
lines.en: I back away so you cannot touch it.
My legs brace my body.

lines.zh: 你看见我背上的东西了吗
lines.en: Do you see what is on my back?
I do not plan to walk away from this.
Step back and I can stay still.
My sac is glowing.
I guard my back and give two steps.
That nearly struck the sac.
I make a low sound.
A leg is broken; it no longer bears me.
I turn slowly.
I dare not run; running would split me.

lines.zh: 液体从我的伤口流到沙上
lines.en: Fluid runs from my wound into the sand.
The moment draws closer.
You had better get far back.
I do not live by my mouth.
You hold something up; I do not look.
My sac matters more than that.

lines.zh: 你把东西放下，然后退开
lines.en: Set it down and then back off.
I do not want this.
I go around it and keep walking.
Too light to be worth anything.
I only want to get closer to you.
I stop and watch your hands.

lines.zh: 你别以为这点东西能收买我
lines.en: Do not think that buys me.
You hit me and the sac sloshes.
I pull back to guard my back.
That nearly burst the sac.
My legs held.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转身，火药味先到。
lines.en: I turn slowly, and the gunpowder smell arrives first.
We press the sand flat.
I did not cry out; something in the sac sounded.
You should not have touched that.
Purple plasma splashes from the desert sand.
That brought the moment closer.

lines.zh: 我们这样的，只有一次机会
lines.en: Our kind get one chance.

lines.zh: 沙漠的虫群，黏球都是我的。
lines.en: The desert swarm. The gel is all mine.
The swarm does not need me to stay long.
The sac is everything.
The other also carries a sac.
We do not come close; too dangerous.
The handover happens under the sand.
I leave what must be left.
Then I leave on my own.
The desert will remember the sound.
This cannot go on my back.
I bury it in the sand with a leg.
Carrying it, I walk slower.
It fell; I will not pick it up.
I cannot bend down.

lines.zh: 这点分量我背着不觉得
lines.en: I do not feel this weight on my back.
It presses against my leg.
I bite it; it is hard.
You have come near.
This distance will do.
I begin to shift toward you.
The sac on my back is swelling.
I do not cry out; a cry would make you run.
The swarm has cleared a path.
The sand behind you is soft.

lines.zh: 我挪得慢，但一直在靠近
lines.en: I move slowly, but I keep closing.
A few more steps.
My slime burns with a charge.
The moment I press against you.
One step, then a look.
You retreat; I still follow.

lines.zh: 我护着囊，不让人从侧面来
lines.en: I guard the sac from the flank.
The swarm is behind me.
My sac grows hotter.

lines.zh: 你跑得快，但我不需要追上
lines.en: You are fast, but I need not catch you.
I only need to be close enough.
Stand still and I will not move.
My legs tremble, and not from fear.
Only the last few steps now.
I stop and lift the sac.
I slam in and pin you down.
The spines on my legs tear skin.
This is not to kill, but to hold.
You cannot break free at all.
My sac presses against you.
I hold you and wait.
This sound will carry across the desert.
Neither of us walks away.

lines.zh: 沙里钻出一个背着囊的东西
lines.en: Something with a sac on its back digs out of the sand.
Sand still clings to my sac.
The desert has always been the swarm's.
I land very carefully.
I head where the swarm is going.
My sac swells for the first time.
The sounds around thin out.
I find an open spot.
My legs settle into the sand.
Fire touches the sac; I pull back fast.

lines.zh: 我从沙丘上滚下去，囊被压了一下
lines.en: I roll down the dune and the sac is squeezed.

lines.zh: 水一压上来，我的囊变重
lines.en: Water closes in and my sac grows heavy.
The blast throws my legs up.

lines.zh: 一根东西钻进我的关节
lines.en: Something burrows into my joint.
That force is pressing my sac.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，我靠别的活着
lines.en: I do not eat; I live on something else.

lines.zh: 雷打在我旁边，我的囊更烫了
lines.en: Lightning strikes beside me; the sac grows hotter.
No sand; I fall.
